text.text_excerpt: First time at Magazine Pizza, and we'll definitely be back! Some of the best pizza I've had in a while. Son had cheese pizza, I had Mediterranean (think gyro meets pizza, with AMAZING tzatziki sauce on the side!). We ate outside, which was nice, but good seating inside, as well. Service was very good. Prices are very reasonable. Casual. Good for kids. Neighborhood place. No alcohol, but BYOB for wine. Too full to try desserts this visit. Def suggest giving them a try!

I was a little skeptical about a place named Magazine Pizza that wasn't on Magazine St., but rather Bienville St. in Mid-city. However, Magazine Pizza definitely exceeded my expectations! The crust they use at MCP is a hand-tossed style crust, rather than thin or deep dish. It's nice and chewy with brushed garlic butter around the edges. They also have a nice selection of pizzas and toppings. Our favorite is the vegetarian Farmer's Market. It's so dang good! I can't seem to bring myself to try any other flavors! I've also tried some of their salads and they are tasty, as well. MCP also offers sandwiches, wraps and calzones. The food is definitely good but so is the service. When you are i...

I would normally give 4 stars but I cannot believe that their first 7 reviews average out to 3 stars so I'm giving 5 to help them out. This is the first time ordering from this location. After trying the pizza a few months back, this has been our favorite pizza in the city (the only positive to the night when the Saints lost to Seattle). We got three smalls: cheese, Mediterranean and Grilled Chicken. All three were delicious and gone within minutes between 4 adults. The delivery took a long time to get to the house but it was late on a Friday night. All three pizzas came with a dipping sauce.
